name: @effect-libs/browser-monorepo
description: Monorepo root for @effect-libs/browser-* packages. Source lives in packages/*; this package is the build/test/docs orchestrator.

scripts.codegen:cdp:protocol:freshness: pnpm codegen:cdp:protocol && pnpm fmt && git diff --quiet packages/browser-cdp/src/internal/CdpProtocol.ts || (echo 'ERROR: packages/browser-cdp/src/internal/CdpProtocol.ts is stale. Run: pnpm codegen:cdp:protocol && pnpm fmt and commit' && exit 1)
scripts.codegen:cdp:snapshot:freshness: if [ ! -d repos/cloudflare-playwright/tests/page ]; then echo 'Skipping CDP snapshot freshness: optional upstream checkout is absent'; else pnpm codegen:cdp:snapshot && pnpm fmt && pnpm exec oxfmt docs/contributing/cdp/upstream-integration-test-snapshot.md && git diff --quiet docs/contributing/cdp/upstream-integration-test-snapshot.md || (echo 'ERROR: docs/contributing/cdp/upstream-integration-test-snapshot.md is stale. Run: pnpm codegen:cdp:snapshot && pnpm fmt and commit' && exit 1); fi
scripts.codegen:cdp:parity-not-planned:freshness: if [ ! -d repos/cloudflare-playwright/tests/page ]; then echo 'Skipping CDP NOT_PLANNED freshness: optional upstream checkout is absent'; else pnpm codegen:cdp:parity-not-planned && pnpm fmt && git diff --quiet tests/integration/shared/cdp/_parityNotPlanned.ts || (echo 'ERROR: tests/integration/shared/cdp/_parityNotPlanned.ts is stale. Run: pnpm codegen:cdp:parity-not-planned && pnpm fmt and commit' && exit 1); fi
scripts.docs: pnpm docs:typecheck && pnpm docs:format && pnpm docs:check-links
scripts.test:all: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration
scripts.check: pnpm check:package-versions && pnpm lint && pnpm exec fallow dead-code --fail-on-issues && tsgo --noEmit && pnpm fmt:check
scripts.check:fix: pnpm fmt && pnpm lint --fix && tsgo --noEmit && pnpm exec fallow dead-code --fail-on-issues
scripts.verify: pnpm codegen:cdp:protocol:freshness && pnpm codegen:cdp:snapshot:freshness && pnpm codegen:cdp:parity-not-planned:freshness && pnpm check && pnpm build && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm test:smoke && pnpm examples:typecheck && pnpm run docs
scripts.verify:release: pnpm run verify && pnpm tsx scripts/test-runner/TestRunner.ts integration --runtime workerd

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: pnpm lint-staged && pnpm tsgo --noEmit && pnpm examples:typecheck && pnpm exec fallow dead-code --fail-on-issues
